title: A reader's journeys
description: How a reader's time with the browser goes, from the link they are given to the thing they came for.

entities.name: First look at a repository
entities.description: Someone has been sent a link to a repository in the browser and wants to understand it.
entities.goal: Understand how the repository is put together, and point a colleague at one part of it.

stages.context: A message or a document links to the browser with ?url= and maybe a folder after #.
stages.outcome: The page names the repository in the bar and says it is listing it.

stages.context: Two requests to list the repository, then one per .dev file.
stages.outcome: The tree and the linked folder appear, or the shallowest folder if none was named.

stages.context: The folder's name, its purpose, the folders inside it and a tab per kind of view.
stages.action: Reads the head of the folder and picks a tab.
stages.outcome: One kind of view is open; its drawing is laid out.

stages.context: A drawing with a legend under it.
stages.action: Hovers parts to see their neighbours, clicks one to read about it.
stages.outcome: They know what the part does and what it depends on.

stages.context: A part with a round badge stands for a folder with views of its own.
stages.outcome: The part grows into the page and the folder opens on the same kind of view, if it has one.

stages.context: The address now names the folder, and a part, view or record when one was opened from a link.
stages.action: Copies the address and sends it on.
stages.outcome: Whoever opens it lands where they were.

entities.name: Reading a private repository
entities.description: A reader opens a repository the host does not show to everyone, and comes back to it later.
entities.goal: Read their own private repository without giving their access to anyone else.

stages.context: The host answers 404 or 401: to a stranger a private repository does not exist.
stages.action: Reads why, and presses Add a token.
stages.outcome: The token panel opens, saying which token the host wants and that it goes to that host alone.

stages.context: They need a token they don't have yet.
stages.touchpoint: The host's settings, outside the browser
stages.action: Makes a token with the right permission.
stages.outcome: They have a token to paste.

stages.context: The panel suggests the owner or group as the token's scope.
stages.action: Pastes it, keeps or changes the scope, ticks Keep it on this browser if it is their own machine, and saves.
stages.outcome: The page reloads and reads the repository.

stages.context: The bar's button now reads Token added.
stages.outcome: Every request to the host carries the token.
A token kept on the browser is used at once; one kept for the tab is gone, and they are asked again.

stages.context: The token has expired or been revoked.
stages.action: Reads that the host refused the token for that scope, and presses Replace or add a token.
stages.outcome: They paste a new one, or forget the old one in the panel.

entities.name: Reviewing what agents have written
entities.description: The owner of a repository whose .dev files agents keep checks what waits on them and how far to trust what is written.
entities.goal: Take the decisions only they can take, and catch what an agent got wrong.

stages.context: Waiting above the tree shows how many records wait.
stages.action: Opens Waiting and reads who each decision waits on and what it blocks.
stages.outcome: They know what is theirs to decide.

stages.context: A decision record with its context, its options and their consequences.
stages.action: Opens the record from the table and reads it.
stages.outcome: They can decide, and tell an agent to record the decision.

stages.context: Each record says whether it was checked against the code (source-verified), only written down (documented) or is intent (proposed).
stages.action: Hovers the badge to see what it means, and reads the record with that in mind.
stages.outcome: They know which claims to check.

stages.context: Read from lists the files and symbols a record or view was read from.
stages.action: Opens a source on the host.
stages.outcome: The code is in a new tab, at the file the record cites.

relatedViews.relationship: The use cases each stage relies on.
